usageNotes: Creates a new HA group that controls which cluster nodes can run HA-managed resources and in what priority order. Note: Proxmox has deprecated HA groups in favor of HA rules, so prefer the rules API for new deployments. Requires `Sys.Console` at the root path (`/`); all nodes listed in the `nodes` parameter must already be members of the cluster.

examples.summary: Create a restricted HA group pinning two VMs to primary node with a failover node

params.comment: Production VMs - prefer pve-node1, failover to pve-node2

tips: Node priority is specified as `nodename:priority` (integer, higher = preferred); omit priority to treat all nodes equally.
With `restricted: true`, HA services in this group will never migrate to nodes outside the group list — use this when VMs must stay on licensed or high-spec nodes.
With `nofailback: false` (default), the CRM will migrate services back to the highest-priority node once it recovers; set `nofailback: true` to suppress that automatic migration.
The `group` identifier follows `pve-configid` format: lowercase alphanumeric and underscores only, no spaces.
This endpoint returns null on success; verify creation with GET /cluster/ha/groups/{group}.
